description: This is a JUnit test class for testing the immutability and equals/hashCode contract of the ImmutableCacheLookupContext class in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.cache package.

classes.name: ImmutableCacheLookupContextTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ImmutableCacheLookupContext, testing its immutability and correct equals/hashCode implementation.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that ImmutableCacheLookupContext instances are immutable and that its related classes are also immutable when using MutabilityDetector.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals() and hashCode() implementations for ImmutableCacheLookupContext using EqualsVerifier.
